patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: (Mom) The back of the little remote was open and the shiny coin-battery is missing. She's drooling a lot and won't drink her juice, keeps gagging a little. She doesn't even look that sick, though.
clinical.presentationShort: 3yo F — suspected coin-cell (button) battery ingestion; now drooling and refusing PO with mild gagging, otherwise well-appearing.
clinical.presentationLong: 3-year-old female, likely swallowed a coin-cell button battery from a remote, now drooling and refusing to drink with mild gagging, though she looks deceptively well.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → STAT X-ray (double-ring/halo sign), honey if <12h and >12mo, emergent endoscopic removal.
diagnosis.why: The child looks fine — that's the trap. A lodged button battery burns the esophagus in hours. Drooling/dysphagia → get it out NOW.
diagnosis.redFlag: Drooling + refusal to drink after a coin-cell battery = esophageal impaction; burns within ~2 hours.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: 3-year-old girl in a dress, deceptively well-looking
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting, drooling slightly, hand near her mouth
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a hispanic 3-year-old girl in a dress, deceptively well-looking, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting, drooling slightly, one hand near her mouth. Expression: uncomfortable and a bit gaggy. Clearly visible: drool on her chin and a hand near her mouth and throat. No text, no logos.
